describe: The image shows the top of a round wooden or metal barrel, with a large dark circular rim and a central disc carrying a cream-coloured printed label. The label has a black ring with the words POWDER in large gold capital letters, plus smaller gold text around the edge and a small diamond in the centre. The surrounding wood-metal surface is dark brown with rust-brown weathering, fine scratches and a slight sheen. Lighting is moderate with dark edges. Fully opaque, no transparent areas.
